summary: Owner isolation and server-controlled entitlement boundaries are enforced and emulator-tested. Admin authority comes from server-provisioned ACL documents. Public reads are limited to catalog and selected app-content documents.

findings.issue: Family member lists are bounded to 20 entries, but individual nested entries are not fully schema-validated in Firestore rules. A user can corrupt their own family-member display data.
findings.recommendation: Use a validated server mutation or a typed family-member subcollection if stronger per-entry schema enforcement is required.
